description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Sticker and Sticker Management System
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the issuance of an order under the Excise Ordinance, specifically prescribing rules related to security features (stickers and a sticker management system) for excisable articles. This falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and a statutory instrument (an order) made under existing legislation.
